purpose: Teach: といふ/劼/氣/ゎ/榮/佛/に当たりまして/翁

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古文書の「といふ」、つまり「という」の医学古典を医療チームで紐解きます
lines.en: Ren — we'll explore old medical texts together as a team, particularly the classical usage of "toifu," which is "toiu."
lines.style: Clear, measured introduction. Slight formal weight on the technical term. Confident but not lecturing. Lets the words settle.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の劼、つまり劼勉な治療への姿勢を医療チームで称えます
lines.en: Ren — we'll acknowledge your patient's earnest commitment to their treatment across our entire medical team.
lines.style: Warm recognition beneath the formality. Slight lift in the voice — genuine praise, not performance. Direct eye contact in the tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「氣」、つまり気の流れの東洋医学を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren — we'll study the flow of qi using the older character form together, integrating traditional Eastern medicine into our approach.
lines.style: Thoughtful pace. Weight on the concept of integration rather than substitution. Steady, respectful tone — honoring both systems.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学古典の小書きのゎ、つまり「わ」の用法を医療チームで読み解きます
lines.en: Ren — we'll work through the classical usage of the small character wa in old medical texts as a team.
lines.style: Educational but unhurried. Slight pause before "wa" — letting it become concrete. Matter-of-fact, like noting a real detail.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「榮」、つまり栄養の古い表記を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren — we'll reference the older character for eï, which relates to nutrition, in our team discussions.
lines.style: Practical, grounded. No flourish. The tone of a doctor noting what will actually help the care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「佛」、つまり仏教の終末期ケア観を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren — we'll honor the traditional Buddhist perspective on end-of-life care in our team's approach.
lines.style: Gentle shift toward gravitas. Respectful cadence. Slower on "end-of-life." This is framework, not checklist.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 診療開始に当たりまして、貴院、ご家族にご説明されますね、先生
lines.en: Doctor, before we begin the care, you'll be explaining everything to the hospital and to the family, won't you?
lines.style: Hesitant, seeking reassurance. Small formality in the phrasing — Ren checking the structure. Quiet, not challenging. Needs to know the path.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ご高齢の翁、つまり老翁の方々のケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — we'll provide care for elderly patients with the same thoughtful attention to their dignity and experience.
lines.style: Warm closing. Slight softness on "elderly patients." Returns to the we-together tone. Concluding but not final — the beginning of something.
